lines: There first to disciple should speak Guru constant rule clearly; his fitness having inspected of far-spreading and opposite-natured.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tatrādau śiśave vrūyādgururnityavidhiṃ sphuṭam tadyogyatāṃ samālokya vitatāvitatātmanām
